codexHistoryReferenceHint: History references the original files and is not added to model context when browsed. The model can read excerpts when needed; those excerpts are saved in the new conversation.
codexHistoryDisabled: History references for this source are disabled in Labs. New conversation can continue.
codexHistoryEmpty: No matching local sessions. You can also choose log files manually.
codexHistoryPreviewHint: Click a session to preview history and select sessions to branch. Multiple sessions branch from their latest completed turns.
codexHistoryStatus_missing: The source file was moved or deleted. Saved new messages and excerpts remain available. Relink the original file to restore history.
codexHistoryStatus_changed: The source changed and the fixed branch point cannot be verified. Relink a matching original file.
codexHistoryStatus_partial: Some history or attachments are unavailable. Available history is still shown.
codexHistoryAttachmentAfterBranch: Create a branch to view source attachments on demand.
codexHistoryAttachmentSaveHint: Save this attachment to view its format.
codexHistoryRecordHint: Read the original text in segments for viewing. This does not add it to the conversation or model context.
codexHistoryRecordAfterBranch: Create a branch to read complete source records in segments.
codexHistoryRecordUnavailable: This source record is unavailable. Check the source file status.
